Weekend speech rba

Speaker: Michele Bullock

Economic outlook

Real GDP is projected to grow by 2.1% in 2026 and by 2.2% in 2027.

Inflation

Inflation is projected to average 3.0% in 2026.

Labour market

The unemployment rate is projected to average 4.4% in 2026.

Financial stability

Financial conditions remained tight and monetary policy transmission continued to function smoothly.

Monetary policy

The Reserve Bank of Australia decided to hold the cash rate.

Monetary policy will remain data dependent as the outlook evolves.

Risks

Risks to inflation were broadly balanced.
